description: Implementation of the ThreadLooper class for managing event-driven thread execution in the modem simulator component of the project.

classes.name: ThreadLooper
classes.description: A class that manages a dedicated thread to process scheduled events with support for posting, canceling, and stopping the event loop.

classes.name: ThreadLooper::Event
classes.description: A nested class representing an individual scheduled event with a timestamp, callback, and serial number.

methods.name: ThreadLooper::ThreadLooper
methods.description: Constructor initializing the thread looper, starting the thread.

methods.name: ThreadLooper::~ThreadLooper
methods.description: Destructor that stops the thread looper.

methods.name: ThreadLooper::Post
methods.description: Posts a callback to be executed as soon as possible, returning a serial number.

methods.name: ThreadLooper::Post
methods.description: Posts a callback to be executed after a specified delay, returning a serial number.

methods.name: ThreadLooper::CancelSerial
methods.description: Cancels a scheduled event based on its serial number.

methods.name: ThreadLooper::Insert
methods.description: Inserts a new event into the priority queue, maintaining order.

methods.name: ThreadLooper::ThreadLoop
methods.description: Main loop running in the thread, executing callbacks when their scheduled time arrives.

methods.name: ThreadLooper::Stop
methods.description: Stops the thread looper, joins the thread.
